changes.title: Wizard token cost 4 → 7
changes.text: Fairy Stockfish has revealed the tactical potency of this piece, and will consistently favor it over a Rook and Pawn. Don't buy it? Give Fairy Stockfish a Wizard and find out!

changes.title: Archer token cost 7 → 5
changes.text: While this piece seems unbeatable at first glance, it takes some effort to prove its value. In an endgame, this piece becomes a lot worse, and due to its low range it is likely worth no more than a Rook. But certainly not more than two Bishops!

changes.title: Snare token cost 2 → 1
changes.text: The Snare cannot capture, and is very weak to attack by Pawns. Giving it a valuation of more than a Pawn seems unfair for this reason.

changes.title: Rolling Snare movement buff
changes.text: The Rolling Snare now moves like a Queen to make it more comparable to Pawn/Painter promotions.
